sources.citation: Mugisa, John Mwesigwa. 2011 [publ. 2012]. The syntactic structure of the VP in Kihema. Stellenbosch Papers in Linguistics 40: 1-19. doi:10.5774/40-0-36

sources.citation: Mugisa, John Mwesigwa. 2005. The verb phrase in Kihema. MA thesis, University of KwaZulu-Natal (supervisor J. Zeller). 148 pp. hdl:10413/9034
sources.note: Nothing. Purely syntactic (causative/applicative/passive in GB/incorporation terms); intro covers geo-linguistic situation (Bahema Boga, Mitego, Sud, Banywagi; notes Runyoro-Rutooro of Uganda as a 'dialectal variety of Kihema') but no phonology; no tone or stress marking in examples; the words stress/accent/tone do not occur.

sources.citation: Thiry, Edmond. 2004. Une introduction à l'ethnohistoire des Hema du Nord (Congo du Nord-Est). Tervuren: Musée royal de l'Afrique centrale (Publications digitales), 127 pp. ISBN 90-75894-65-1
sources.note: Nothing. Ethnohistory of the Northern Hema (Ba-gegere, Ba-nywagi, Ba-jere), who have shifted to Lendu (bba dha); only remark on language is that Southern Hema keep 'la langue du Bunyoro (le nyoro)' while it 'achève de disparaître chez les Hema du Nord' (p.1). Glottolog's hhtype 'grammar_sketch' for this item is a mis-tag.
